verdicts.reason: Both use the same banner layout. 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' sits alone at the far left, cut off from the title it labels. The confetti is squeezed into a dense patch in the middle-left instead of spread across the canvas, and the owls are shrunk to tiny icons. In B the brown owl's party hat touches the 'K' of 'KIDS BIRTHDAY STUDIO', a clear collision. A keeps a small gap between the owls and the headline, so it is slightly cleaner.
